Collect tidy metrics

Source: R/results.R, R/sets.R
collect_metrics.Rd

Like tune::collect_metrics(). With summarize = TRUE, one row per design (and scenario, when there are several) and metric, with the mean across replicates, the number of replicates n and the Monte Carlo standard error std_err. When scenarios are pooled, each seed's value is first averaged over scenarios so the standard error stays paired by seed.

Usage

collect_metrics(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'sim_results'
collect_metrics(
  x,
  ...,
  summarize = TRUE,
  by_scenario = NULL,
  type = c("long", "wide")
)

# S3 method for class 'sim_set'
collect_metrics(
  x,
  ...,
  summarize = TRUE,
  by_scenario = NULL,
  type = c("long", "wide")
)

Arguments

x

A sim_results object.

...

Not used.

summarize

Summarize over replicates (TRUE) or return one row per design, scenario and replicate (FALSE).

by_scenario

Summarize within each scenario. Defaults to TRUE when the study has more than one scenario.

type

"long" (one row per metric, like tune) or "wide" (one row per design, a column per metric and <metric>_se columns).

Value

A tibble.
